sources.researchNote: The register prints the composer name as the pseudonym alone and does not resolve it. The Walter Jurmann works catalogue gives the song as a collaboration with Bronisław Kaper, “Walter Jurmann als Bob Henders”, and the 1932 copyright index enters the pseudonymous registration under Walter Jurmann.

works.publicNote: The lyric is signed “P. Kuckuck”. The film’s two other songs appeared under the joint composer pseudonym “Ernst Martin”, and in 1933 such a name could be an ordinary trade pseudonym or a cover for a Jewish author; the sources do not allow the two to be told apart. GEMA and the Library of Congress register Peter Kuckuck as the lyricist without resolving the name further.
